tracking_notes: Manual/public-index tracking only: active listings, price changes, comments/offers, sold-marked items, listing disappearance, and archived/search-index traces. Do not scrape or automate retrieval from Adverts.ie; its current Terms prohibit automated retrieval/indexing and database construction. Useful local benchmark for singles, part-outs, promos and themed mini-groups. Historical/public-index backfill seeded 2026-09-05 in data/reference/local_seller_history.csv.

Standing Irish high-retail ceiling benchmark. Treat asking prices as upper local retail context, not fair market value. Give more weight to actual offers, corroborated accepted offers, seller/platform sold states and other evidence of realized buyer willingness. Compare alongside Cardmarket English+NM and European eBay evidence. Manual/public-index tracking only; do not automate Adverts.ie retrieval where prohibited by platform Terms.

High-priority full-binder/value benchmark. Seller has repeatedly listed 2016-modern Pokemon binders with rare/holo/reverse-holo content. Two comparable binders (40926024/40926025) were offered at €20; 40926025 had a €20 offer accepted plus multiple backup €20 offers and the pair were later seller/platform marked sold in a user-supplied snapshot. Similar later binders 40960653/40960632 were repriced to €39 after heavy demand. Treat €20 as strong evidence of rapid buyer demand at that level, but do not assume €39 is realized market until sold evidence appears. High-priority alert on new comparable full binders at <=€25; €26-32 is attractive/good-buy territory; ~€39 is fair/watch territory pending sale evidence. Revalidate thresholds as new sales occur. Manual/public-index tracking only; no prohibited automated Adverts.ie scraping/indexing.

Direct competitor benchmark for kids/starter bundles. Current 50-card English pack-fresh bundle is €7: 1 V/EX, 1 reverse holo, 3 holo rares, 5 Trainers, 10 Energy and 30 C/UC with no duplicates. Seller has shown repeat buyer interest and offered 2 bundles for €13 including postage; profile feedback includes buyers praising card quality/delivery. Also useful for raw-bulk calibration: Vivid Voltage C/UC at 100 for €6 or 200 for €10; Energy at 50 for €3 or 200 for €10. Use this seller to test whether our planned €10/50-card product offers enough extra value via theme, better hero-card appeal, fewer filler Energy cards, packaging/presentation, or local convenience. Do not infer a sale from €1 PM placeholder offers alone. Manual/public-index tracking only; no prohibited automated Adverts.ie scraping/indexing.

Track visible sticker prices at Dublin pop-up stock, especially €5–15 raw singles. Use as face-to-face Irish retail ceiling and occasional sourcing lead. Separate English and Japanese comps; in-person inspection/no postage can justify a modest premium over Cardmarket, but not large markup.
